note: Protected/admin prototype projection. Canonical Atlas A5 semantics remain authoritative; these definitions are additive derived execution assets.

definitions.taskLabel: Resolve service demand and execution eligibility
definitions.queuePurpose: Eligibility / validation. Reference queue compiled from LTL-01 — Resolve service demand and execution eligibility.

workTypes.name: New Request
workTypes.purpose: New Request handling for Service Eligibility.

workTypes.name: Eligibility Exception
workTypes.purpose: Eligibility Exception handling for Service Eligibility.

workTypes.name: Override Review
workTypes.purpose: Override Review handling for Service Eligibility.

rules: Serviceability, commodity, size/weight, prohibited-goods, lane, cut-off and contract rules must pass.
controls: Eligibility rule version and override authority recorded.
actions: Create or reject the transport service request with reason.

definitions.taskLabel: Classify, rate and commit the commercial offer
definitions.queuePurpose: Rating / commercial decision. Reference queue compiled from LTL-02 — Classify, rate and commit the commercial offer.

workTypes.name: New Rating
workTypes.purpose: New Rating handling for Classification & Rating.

workTypes.name: Re-rate / Change
workTypes.purpose: Re-rate / Change handling for Classification & Rating.

workTypes.name: Pricing Referral
workTypes.purpose: Pricing Referral handling for Classification & Rating.

rules: Use contract/tariff hierarchy, effective dates, verified attributes and approval tolerances; NMFC only in its applicable North-American relationship.
controls: Preserve input measures, classification/rate version, exception approvals and quoted-to-executed linkage.
actions: Determine class/rating basis, calculate offer and record commitment or controlled referral.

definitions.taskLabel: Create and validate shipment, consignment and transport-document identity
definitions.queuePurpose: Documentation / identity. Reference queue compiled from LTL-03 — Create and validate shipment, consignment and transport-document identity.

workTypes.name: Create / Validate
workTypes.purpose: Create / Validate handling for Shipment & Transport Documentation.

workTypes.name: Amend / Correct
workTypes.purpose: Amend / Correct handling for Shipment & Transport Documentation.

workTypes.name: Blocked / Incomplete
workTypes.purpose: Blocked / Incomplete handling for Shipment & Transport Documentation.

rules: Reuse Page‑0 atomic objects; distinguish shipment, consignment and transport document; apply eBOL, CMR/e-CMR or national form only when scope resolves.
controls: Uniqueness, required-field, version, duplicate and amendment controls.
actions: Create canonical shipment/consignment records and issue or prepare the applicable transport document.

definitions.taskLabel: Request pickup and prove shipment readiness
definitions.queuePurpose: Request / scheduling. Reference queue compiled from LTL-04 — Request pickup and prove shipment readiness.

workTypes.name: New
workTypes.purpose: New handling for Pickup Request.

workTypes.name: Change / Reschedule
workTypes.purpose: Change / Reschedule handling for Pickup Request.

workTypes.name: Cancellation
workTypes.purpose: Cancellation handling for Pickup Request.

rules: Valid identity, serviceability, pickup window, cargo readiness and condition-specific prerequisites required.
controls: Request/response correlation, idempotency, change/cancel reason and stale-version rejection.
actions: Schedule, update/reschedule or cancel pickup and publish response.

definitions.taskLabel: Dispatch pickup, accept freight and establish custody
definitions.queuePurpose: Physical acceptance. Reference queue compiled from LTL-05 — Dispatch pickup, accept freight and establish custody.

workTypes.name: Dispatch / Present
workTypes.purpose: Dispatch / Present handling for Pickup Acceptance & Custody.

workTypes.name: Accept with Reservation
workTypes.purpose: Accept with Reservation handling for Pickup Acceptance & Custody.

workTypes.name: Refusal
workTypes.purpose: Refusal handling for Pickup Acceptance & Custody.

rules: Identity, count, apparent condition, prohibited/controlled-goods and document checks must pass or reservations/refusal be recorded.
controls: Positive identity match, timestamp/location, condition/count variance and custody acknowledgement.
actions: Dispatch, inspect presented freight, accept with/without reservation, or refuse with reason.

definitions.taskLabel: Receive at origin service centre and verify handling-unit state
definitions.queuePurpose: Inspection / reconciliation. Reference queue compiled from LTL-06 — Receive at origin service centre and verify handling-unit state.

workTypes.name: Standard Receipt
workTypes.purpose: Standard Receipt handling for Origin Receipt.

workTypes.name: Discrepancy / Hold
workTypes.purpose: Discrepancy / Hold handling for Origin Receipt.

workTypes.name: Reweigh / Reclass Review
workTypes.purpose: Reweigh / Reclass Review handling for Origin Receipt.

rules: Receive only against authoritative shipment/handling-unit identity; quarantine or case any discrepancy.
controls: Scan/measurement provenance, scale/device validity where required, duplicate/missing-unit and damage controls.
actions: Unload, identify, inspect, measure/reweigh where controlled, receive or hold.

definitions.taskLabel: Build consolidation and authorize origin load
definitions.queuePurpose: Planning / authorization. Reference queue compiled from LTL-07 — Build consolidation and authorize origin load.

workTypes.name: Plan / Build Load
workTypes.purpose: Plan / Build Load handling for Origin Consolidation & Load Authorization.

workTypes.name: Load Authorization
workTypes.purpose: Load Authorization handling for Origin Consolidation & Load Authorization.

workTypes.name: Blocked / Constraint Review
workTypes.purpose: Blocked / Constraint Review handling for Origin Consolidation & Load Authorization.

rules: Capacity, route, compatibility, segregation, cut-off, custody and load-integrity rules must pass.
controls: Planned-versus-scanned unit reconciliation and supervisor release for exceptions.
actions: Group handling units, assign route/leg/equipment, stage/load and authorize departure.

definitions.taskLabel: Execute line-haul leg and publish actual movement state
definitions.queuePurpose: Movement / event management. Reference queue compiled from LTL-08 — Execute line-haul leg and publish actual movement state.

workTypes.name: Dispatch / In Transit
workTypes.purpose: Dispatch / In Transit handling for Line-haul Execution.

workTypes.name: Stop / Delay Exception
workTypes.purpose: Stop / Delay Exception handling for Line-haul Execution.

workTypes.name: Arrival
workTypes.purpose: Arrival handling for Line-haul Execution.

rules: Only authorized load/resource may depart; actual events must preserve leg, load and unit correlation.
controls: Departure gate, route/deviation monitoring, event chronology and unresolved-hold block.
actions: Depart, move, update actual state, arrive or safely stop/escalate.

definitions.taskLabel: Unload, sort and cross-dock at an intermediate service centre
definitions.queuePurpose: Node handling. Reference queue compiled from LTL-09 — Unload, sort and cross-dock at an intermediate service centre.

workTypes.name: Inbound / Sort
workTypes.purpose: Inbound / Sort handling for Intermediate Cross-dock.

workTypes.name: Hold / Missort
workTypes.purpose: Hold / Missort handling for Intermediate Cross-dock.

workTypes.name: Outbound Transfer
workTypes.purpose: Outbound Transfer handling for Intermediate Cross-dock.

rules: Positive identity, custody continuity, route eligibility, condition and cut-off controls must pass; unresolved units move to exception state.
controls: Inbound-to-outbound scan reconciliation, missort prevention, damage/shortage capture and controlled release.
actions: Unload, scan, sort, stage, cross-dock, hold or redirect.

definitions.taskLabel: Transfer or interchange to the next network leg
definitions.queuePurpose: Handoff / custody. Reference queue compiled from LTL-10 — Transfer or interchange to the next network leg.

workTypes.name: Transfer Offer
workTypes.purpose: Transfer Offer handling for Network Transfer / Interchange.

workTypes.name: Transfer Acceptance
workTypes.purpose: Transfer Acceptance handling for Network Transfer / Interchange.

workTypes.name: Blocked / Hold
workTypes.purpose: Blocked / Hold handling for Network Transfer / Interchange.

rules: Leg-by-leg carrier, contract, document, custody and legal scope must be resolved; do not merge regimes.
controls: Successor identity/authority, handoff evidence, document correlation and unresolved-scope lock.
actions: Offer, accept/reject, hand over and open the next leg; or hold/escalate.

definitions.taskLabel: Deconsolidate and build the destination-delivery load
definitions.queuePurpose: Destination planning. Reference queue compiled from LTL-11 — Deconsolidate and build the destination-delivery load.

workTypes.name: Deconsolidation
workTypes.purpose: Deconsolidation handling for Destination Deconsolidation & Load Build.

workTypes.name: Delivery Load Build
workTypes.purpose: Delivery Load Build handling for Destination Deconsolidation & Load Build.

workTypes.name: Hold / Exception
workTypes.purpose: Hold / Exception handling for Destination Deconsolidation & Load Build.

rules: Receipt reconciliation, active holds, service/recipient constraints, route capacity and delivery readiness must pass.
controls: Inbound/unit reconciliation, hold block, route assignment and planned-versus-loaded check.
actions: Unload, deconsolidate, stage, assign route/stop and build delivery load.

definitions.taskLabel: Confirm destination readiness, appointment and delivery dispatch
definitions.queuePurpose: Appointment / dispatch. Reference queue compiled from LTL-12 — Confirm destination readiness, appointment and delivery dispatch.

workTypes.name: Appointment / Confirm
workTypes.purpose: Appointment / Confirm handling for Delivery Readiness & Dispatch.

workTypes.name: Reschedule
workTypes.purpose: Reschedule handling for Delivery Readiness & Dispatch.

workTypes.name: Hold / Redirect
workTypes.purpose: Hold / Redirect handling for Delivery Readiness & Dispatch.

rules: Valid recipient/location, appointment, access constraints, holds, service and special-condition prerequisites required.
controls: Latest-instruction/version check, hold check, appointment acknowledgement and dispatch authority.
actions: Confirm/reschedule appointment, dispatch, hold or redirect.

definitions.taskLabel: Attempt delivery, capture acceptance/reservations and close custody
definitions.queuePurpose: Delivery / acceptance. Reference queue compiled from LTL-13 — Attempt delivery, capture acceptance/reservations and close custody.

workTypes.name: Delivery Attempt
workTypes.purpose: Delivery Attempt handling for Delivery Attempt & Acceptance.

workTypes.name: Reservation / Damage / Short
workTypes.purpose: Reservation / Damage / Short handling for Delivery Attempt & Acceptance.

workTypes.name: Failed / Refused
workTypes.purpose: Failed / Refused handling for Delivery Attempt & Acceptance.

rules: Identity, authorization, actual count/condition, exception reason and applicable signature/evidence requirements must pass.
controls: Geotime/user/device provenance, tamper-resistant evidence, reservation/refusal and failed-attempt reason controls.
actions: Deliver and obtain acceptance/reservation, or record failed attempt/refusal and trigger recovery.

definitions.taskLabel: Detect, classify and assign execution variance
definitions.queuePurpose: Exception triage. Reference queue compiled from LTL-14 — Detect, classify and assign execution variance.

workTypes.name: New Exception
workTypes.purpose: New Exception handling for Execution Exception.

workTypes.name: Classify / Triage
workTypes.purpose: Classify / Triage handling for Execution Exception.

workTypes.name: Assign / Escalate
workTypes.purpose: Assign / Escalate handling for Execution Exception.

rules: Do not assign root cause to detection location; correlate object lineage, upstream process, system/role and downstream impact.
controls: Duplicate-case prevention, severity model, owner/clock assignment and evidence preservation.
actions: Open/classify case, preserve evidence, assign owner and response clock, communicate/escalate.

definitions.taskLabel: Contain, replan and recover service
definitions.queuePurpose: Recovery orchestration. Reference queue compiled from LTL-15 — Contain, replan and recover service.

workTypes.name: Recovery Plan
workTypes.purpose: Recovery Plan handling for Service Recovery.

workTypes.name: Recovery Execution
workTypes.purpose: Recovery Execution handling for Service Recovery.

workTypes.name: Escalation / Closure
workTypes.purpose: Escalation / Closure handling for Service Recovery.

rules: Recovery cannot precede detection/ownership; respect holds, custody, contract, safety and legal scope.
controls: Decision record, authority, alternative evaluation, action confirmation, state reconciliation and closure evidence.
actions: Hold, rework, redirect, redeliver, return, substitute, communicate, settle or escalate as permitted.

definitions.taskLabel: Calculate preliminary and executed freight charges
definitions.queuePurpose: Financial calculation. Reference queue compiled from LTL-16 — Calculate preliminary and executed freight charges.

workTypes.name: Preliminary Charge
workTypes.purpose: Preliminary Charge handling for Freight Charge Calculation.

workTypes.name: Recalculation / Variance
workTypes.purpose: Recalculation / Variance handling for Freight Charge Calculation.

workTypes.name: Billable / Dispute
workTypes.purpose: Billable / Dispute handling for Freight Charge Calculation.

rules: Reconcile contract/rate version, measured facts, service events, accessorial evidence, tax context and approval tolerance.
controls: Quote-to-charge comparison, duplicate charge, effective-rate, evidence and approval controls.
actions: Calculate preliminary/executed charges; accrue, refer variance or publish billable amount.

definitions.taskLabel: Invoice, audit, approve and settle transport obligations
definitions.queuePurpose: Invoice / settlement. Reference queue compiled from LTL-17 — Invoice, audit, approve and settle transport obligations.

workTypes.name: Invoice Issue / Receipt
workTypes.purpose: Invoice Issue / Receipt handling for Invoice Audit & Settlement.

workTypes.name: Audit / Approval
workTypes.purpose: Audit / Approval handling for Invoice Audit & Settlement.

workTypes.name: Dispute
workTypes.purpose: Dispute handling for Invoice Audit & Settlement.

workTypes.name: Settlement
workTypes.purpose: Settlement handling for Invoice Audit & Settlement.

rules: No approval without authoritative charge/evidence; preserve original invoice and controlled adjustment; segregate duties.
controls: Duplicate, three-way/evidence match, tolerance, approval, beneficiary and payment-release controls.
actions: Issue/receive, validate, match, approve, reject/dispute, post and settle.

definitions.taskLabel: Adjudicate cargo/service claim or billing dispute
definitions.queuePurpose: Claim / dispute. Reference queue compiled from LTL-18 — Adjudicate cargo/service claim or billing dispute.

workTypes.name: New Claim / Dispute
workTypes.purpose: New Claim / Dispute handling for Claim / Billing Dispute.

workTypes.name: Evidence / Investigation
workTypes.purpose: Evidence / Investigation handling for Claim / Billing Dispute.

workTypes.name: Decision
workTypes.purpose: Decision handling for Claim / Billing Dispute.

workTypes.name: Settlement / Recovery
workTypes.purpose: Settlement / Recovery handling for Claim / Billing Dispute.

rules: Keep cargo/service claim, billing dispute and insurance recovery separate; apply only resolved contract/regime/policy.
controls: Completeness, evidence integrity, conflict, reserve, authority, time-bar and settlement controls.
actions: Acknowledge, investigate, request evidence, reserve, decide, settle/decline and pursue recovery/subrogation where valid.

definitions.taskLabel: Resolve regulatory scope, operate hold/release and retain evidence
definitions.queuePurpose: Compliance / regulatory. Reference queue compiled from LTL-19 — Resolve regulatory scope, operate hold/release and retain evidence.

workTypes.name: Scope / Screening
workTypes.purpose: Scope / Screening handling for Regulatory Hold / Release.

workTypes.name: Filing / Response
workTypes.purpose: Filing / Response handling for Regulatory Hold / Release.

workTypes.name: Hold / Release
workTypes.purpose: Hold / Release handling for Regulatory Hold / Release.

workTypes.name: Research Required
workTypes.purpose: Research Required handling for Regulatory Hold / Release.

rules: No regime loads from mode name alone; resolve legal scope separately and block movement when an operative hold exists.
controls: Source/effective-date record, filing correlation, authority-response provenance and hold-release segregation.
actions: Classify/screen, file where required, receive response, inspect, hold, release or escalate.

definitions.taskLabel: Assure vehicle, equipment and qualified resource readiness
definitions.queuePurpose: Resource / qualification. Reference queue compiled from LTL-20 — Assure vehicle, equipment and qualified resource readiness.

workTypes.name: Assignment
workTypes.purpose: Assignment handling for Resource Readiness.

workTypes.name: Inspection / Qualification
workTypes.purpose: Inspection / Qualification handling for Resource Readiness.

workTypes.name: Substitute / Block
workTypes.purpose: Substitute / Block handling for Resource Readiness.

rules: Capacity, compatibility, maintenance, inspection, qualification and condition-specific requirements must pass.
controls: Authoritative availability/inspection record and controlled override.
actions: Allocate, inspect, substitute or block resource.

definitions.taskLabel: Reconcile party, location, shipment, unit and network identities
definitions.queuePurpose: Master-data reconciliation. Reference queue compiled from LTL-21 — Reconcile party, location, shipment, unit and network identities.

workTypes.name: New Conflict
workTypes.purpose: New Conflict handling for Identity Reconciliation.

workTypes.name: Reconcile / Correct
workTypes.purpose: Reconcile / Correct handling for Identity Reconciliation.

workTypes.name: Blocked / Stewardship
workTypes.purpose: Blocked / Stewardship handling for Identity Reconciliation.

rules: Apply Page‑0 object authority; never merge shipment, consignment, handling unit, document or equipment into one compound object.
controls: Stewardship, survivorship, version, uniqueness and consumer acknowledgement.
actions: Resolve, map, correct, republish and acknowledge trusted identity/version.

definitions.taskLabel: Coordinate customer communication and resolution evidence
definitions.queuePurpose: Case / customer service. Reference queue compiled from LTL-22 — Coordinate customer communication and resolution evidence.

workTypes.name: New Enquiry / Case
workTypes.purpose: New Enquiry / Case handling for Customer Service Resolution.

workTypes.name: Waiting / Information
workTypes.purpose: Waiting / Information handling for Customer Service Resolution.

workTypes.name: Resolution
workTypes.purpose: Resolution handling for Customer Service Resolution.

workTypes.name: Escalation / Claim Link
workTypes.purpose: Escalation / Claim Link handling for Customer Service Resolution.

rules: Use authoritative shipment/case state; protect data; do not promise recovery/credit outside authority.
controls: Identity/authentication, case linkage, SLA, approval and communication-history controls.
actions: Acknowledge, explain, coordinate, notify, resolve or escalate.
